card.name: V inside medical abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letter V (or BV, GV, CV) ending a capitalized medical abbreviation such as HBV, cGVHD, vGCV or EPIVIR-HBV. Also fires on a stray b or v inside a long word or letter string.

modes.label: Virus or disease abbreviations
modes.description: The final V or GV of an abbreviation for a virus, drug name or graft-versus-host disease.
modes.example: HB<<V>> prior to or when initiating DOVATO

modes.description: GV in the abbreviation for chronic graft-versus-host disease in dosing text.
